thread:
Maria: Heads-up: I'm putting together a short SDK guidance doc for error -> exception mapping, debug logging conventions, and stream resume behavior. Want it to be consistent across languages (JS/Go/Python). Drop quick takes and small snippets.

AJ: Sounds good. Top items for me: mapping table of HTTP -> exception, how corr/trace ids are surfaced in SDKs, and retry recommendations. I can do the mapping table.

Samir: Quick mapping draft (short):
- 400 -> ValidationError (no retry)
- 401 -> AuthenticationError (hint: refresh token flow)
- 403 -> AuthorizationError (no retry)
- 404 -> NotFoundError
- 409 -> ConflictError (include idempotency hint)
- 429 -> RateLimitError (read Retry-After)
- 5xx (500/502/503/504) -> TransientServerError (retryable)
- stream closed mid-chunk -> StreamInterruptedError (resume_token if provided)

Lee: For correlation id naming, let's standardize on header: `X-Correlation-Id`. Also accept `traceparent` (W3C) and map to `trace_id` in SDKs. SDKs should: 1) log the corr id at debug/error, 2) attach it to exceptions as `.correlation_id`, and 3) generate and inject `generated:<uuid>` when missing.

Maria: Example JS error wrapper (very small):
```js
class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor({status, code, message, correlation_id, help_url}) {
    super(message)
    this.status = status
    this.code = code
    this.correlation_id = correlation_id
    this.help_url = help_url
  }
}
```

Samir: And a lightweight fetch wrapper to ensure header + error attach:
```js
const corr = options.headers['X-Correlation-Id'] || uuidv4()
options.headers['X-Correlation-Id'] = corr
const res = await fetch(url, options)
if (!res.ok) {
  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
  throw new ApiError({
    status: res.status,
    code: body.code || null,
    message: body.message || res.statusText,
    correlation_id: body.correlation_id || corr,
    help_url: body.docs || null
  })
}
return res.json()
```

Lee: Go pattern note: return typed error with `CorrelationID string` field and implement `Error()`. Log like: `log.WithField("corr", err.CorrelationID).Error("api call failed")`. Also mask auth headers when logging headers.

AJ: Streaming edgecases we've seen: server may send 200 then close stream without final metadata. SDK behavior: always attach handshake correlation id to stream session and surface that if later chunks omit it. If the API supports resume, include `resume_token` events.

Samir: Proposed stream checkpoint event shape: `{ "type": "checkpoint", "seq": 12345, "resume_token": "r_abc" }`. SDKs should persist last checkpoint for short reconnect windows.

Maria: Retry guidance (short): for idempotent endpoints (embeddings, read-only generation when prompt+model identical), permit retries on 429/5xx with exponential backoff and jitter, configurable max attempts. For non-idempotent generation endpoints, default to NOT auto-retrying; mark TransientServerError.retryable = true so callers can opt in.

Lee: Logging rules: DEBUG -> full request/response headers (mask Authorization, API keys), body optionally truncated; ERROR -> status, error code, correlation_id, short message snippet. Example: `ERROR: api.call status=503 code=server_overload corr=123e4567 msg=\"upstream timeout\"`.

AJ: Small DX improvement: server can include `docs` or `help_url` in error payload. SDK surfaces as `err.help_url` so users get a targeted docs link in errors.

Maria: Naming: prefer `correlation_id` in SDK objects and support `traceparent` -> `trace_id` mapping. Anything else?

Samir: Test idea: add integration test for streams where server omits corr header in mid-chunk to ensure SDK uses session handshake id.

Lee: Also add a unit test for fetch wrapper to ensure correlation id propagates to thrown errors.

Maria: Great. I'll compile these into a short RFC and share tomorrow. If folks have a Python snippet or TypeScript variant, paste it here and I'll include. :thumbsup:
